main.reconciliation: GDD clause 11 defines the Main Deck as 40-80 cards. The later phrase up to 40 is recorded as a request for a 40-card target, not a replacement of the explicit 40-80 GDD range; legality therefore keeps the authoritative 40-80 range.

fusion_extra.research_basis: The official contemporary rulebook reference used for this project specifies an Extra Deck maximum of 15 and treats Fusion Monsters as a separate collection. This is a researched project choice, not a claim that the historic Power of Chaos executable enforced this exact cap.

narrator.cadence: repeat after each threshold while no meaningful action observation occurs

normal_tribute.overlap_resolution: The source wording lists both 7-8 as two tributes and 8-9 as three tributes. The more specific later 8-9 tier takes precedence at exactly eight stars; the seven-star value remains two tributes.
normal_tribute.special_requirement: A ten-star-or-higher monster cannot use the ordinary normal-tribute path and requires an authored special summon procedure.

trio_distribution.rng: sha256(world distribution sequence, team id, member id, card id)
